subject: a young wandering Chinese Taoist traveler
setting: a misty mountain bamboo forest beside an abandoned ancient temple at dusk
action: the traveler walks cautiously along the narrow path

character_lock.identity: the same young wandering Chinese Taoist traveler
character_lock.face: a narrow youthful face, gently arched brows and watchful dark eyes
character_lock.hair: black hair tied into a small practical topknot
character_lock.costume: a worn gray-blue robe with a plain dark cloth sash
character_lock.props: a woven bamboo basket on his back and one weathered wooden staff
character_lock.silhouette: a lean figure with a rounded basket and a straight wooden staff

palette: muted bamboo green, blue-gray mist and a small warm amber lantern accent

shots.action: he places one cautious step on the damp stone path
shots.camera: wide establishing shot from behind, path leading toward the temple
shots.lighting: cool dusk filtered through bamboo, faint distant amber glow

shots.action: he stops and turns his gaze toward one paper lantern floating without support
shots.camera: medium three-quarter shot, traveler and floating lantern both visible
shots.lighting: warm lantern glow on one side of his face, cool mist behind

shots.setting: the weathered temple gate framed by dark bamboo and thin mist
shots.action: he leans forward slightly while the floating lantern hangs beside the open gate
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder view toward the temple doorway
shots.lighting: a localized amber paper-lantern glow against a blue-gray doorway
